text.content:
How Coronado City became Night City.

When: 1998–2005
Where: Night City
Who was involved: The mob, Richard Night's "dirty friends", and the corporations
What it changed: The corporations took the city, and built the Corporate Center

Richard Night founded Coronado City in 1994 as a planned corporate city on Del Coronado Bay. When he was shot dead in 1998, the city took his name and the mob took the streets. The corporations ended the Mob Wars the only way corporations end things: they hired more guns than the mob could. By the 2010s Night City was a company town for a dozen companies at once, with a Corporate Center at its heart and Combat Zones around its edges. The Falcone family came west from New York for the Mob Wars, and stayed.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01
